subject.title: fix(gateway): OAuth-only xAI tools are missing from CLI-backend sessions

question: Should this PR be the canonical landing path for OAuth-only xAI tools on CLI-backend loopback sessions, or should maintainers prefer a sibling PR?
rationale: The code path is auth-sensitive and there are multiple viable same-root-cause PRs, so automation should not choose and merge duplicate branches without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Merge this branch after required checks because it has broad regression coverage and an in-repo proof script, then close the sibling PRs as duplicates.

options.title: Prefer a sibling PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102045 or another sibling if maintainers value a smaller diff over this PR's extra tests and proof script.

options.title: Require credentialed E2E first
options.body: Pause all sibling PRs until a maintainer gets a full live xAI OAuth plus CLI-backend session proof.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Merge this branch after required checks because it has broad regression coverage and an in-repo proof script, then close the sibling PRs as duplicates.
